Join us in “giving our roses” to Union Street. Guests are invited to immerse themselves in an atmosphere of beauty, creativity, and connection-where music, visual art, and shared purpose come together in support of the arts. This event is more than a celebration-it is a meaningful investment in the future of the arts.
